description: ignorePaths lists generated copies only. Each path below is rewritten by scripts/sync_shared_lib.py or scripts/sync_synthetic_monitoring_variants.py, so a Renovate PR against one is reverted by the next sync.

The source modules shared/reporter, synthetic_monitoring_shared/launcher and synthetic_monitoring_shared/ui must stay managed. A wildcard */reporter/** also matched shared/reporter, which silently took the module every App compiles from out of Renovate's reach and let a transitive CVE sit unproposed.

customManagers.description: Track the Grafana Alloy release pinned in the App Dockerfile. This is the single source of truth for the version - alloy/tests/generate-config.test.sh parses it out of the same line.
Track the yamllint release `just lint` runs through uvx. Unpinned, uvx caches whatever was latest on first use, so lint behaviour drifts between a developer machine, a cloud agent and CI.

packageRules.description: Keep the App build, manifest, and multi-architecture matrix actions on one Home Assistant builder release.
Keep Home Assistant metadata and App discovery helpers on one actions revision.
Keep the development container on the Home Assistant supported major
